name: Eating Disorders
overview: Scripture reminds believers that their bodies are fearfully and wonderfully made by God, who rejoices over them with love and singing, emphasizing their inherent worth beyond physical appearance. Christians are called to present their bodies as living sacrifices, honoring God rather than being consumed by anxiety over food or outward adornment. Trusting in Christ’s strength and bringing all concerns to Him in prayer helps believers find peace and freedom from destructive patterns related to eating and self-image.
